ground_truth.description: Cross-chain deposit flow lacks validation of restriction roles. While SOFT_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE prevents local staking, the OFT adapter path through LayerZero bypasses these checks.
ground_truth.root_cause: Cross-chain deposit flow lacks validation of restriction roles. While SOFT_RESTRICTED_STAKER_ROLE prevents local staking, the OFT adapter path through LayerZero bypasses these checks.
ground_truth.fix_description: Validate the _depositor parameter in _depositAndSend() before calling VAULT.deposit().
